publication: explicit host acknowledgement and separate key-bound enrolment
meaning: Host transport profile, not a universal desktop-app configuration. No Authorization value is included. The server may expose writing tools; this supplied reading client uses a closed read-only method list. Initialization-based clients can use the documented legacy alternative; compatibility is limited to tested profiles.

legacy_alternative.headers: Let the client negotiate; do not copy the modern protocol header.
legacy_alternative.responses: bounded SSE per POST; no server session or standalone GET stream
